title: Large-Scale Bayesian Tensor Reconstruction via Approximate Message Passing
abstract: arXiv:2505.16305v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While CANDECOMP/PARAFAC (CP) decomposition (CPD) is fundamental for tensor reconstruction, Bayesian CPD often scales poorly because variational updates require repeated matrix inversions. We develop CP generalized approximate message passing (CP-GAMP) for incomplete noisy Bayesian CPD. The algorithm uses Gaussian message approximations to avoid high-dimensional inversions, and it combines a Bernoulli-Gaussian prior with expectation-maximization updates to estimate effective CP rank and noise variance. We also give a formal state evolution (SE) recursion and relate its fixed points to replica-symmetric saddle points, so CP-GAMP's SE-predicted error can be compared with the formal replica-symmetric minimum mean-squared error (MMSE) benchmark in the matched limit. Synthetic and image-inpainting experiments show that CP-GAMP substantially reduces runtime relative to variational Bayesian CPD while maintaining competitive reconstruction ac

translated_title: 基于近似消息传递的大规模贝叶斯张量重构
translated_abstract: 虽然 CANDECOMP/PARAFAC (CP) 分解（CPD）是张量重构的基础方法，但贝叶斯 CPD 的可扩展性往往较差，因为变分更新需要反复进行矩阵求逆。我们开发了 CP 广义近似消息传递（CP-GAMP）算法，用于不完整含噪观测下的贝叶斯 CP 分解。该算法利用高斯消息近似来避免高维矩阵求逆，并结合伯努利-高斯先验与期望最大化（EM）更新来估计有效的 CP 秩和噪声方差。我们还给出了形式化的状态演化（SE）递归，并将其不动点与副本对称鞍点联系起来，使得 CP-GAMP 的 SE 预测误差可以在匹配极限下与形式化的副本对称最小均方误差（MMSE）基准进行比较。合成数据与图像修复实验表明，CP-GAMP 在保持具有竞争力的重构精度的同时，相较于变分贝叶斯 CPD 大幅降低了运行时间。
tldr: 提出 CP-GAMP 算法，通过高斯消息近似与伯努利-高斯先验避免了高维矩阵求逆，在大规模贝叶斯张量重构中大幅降低运行时间并保持具有竞争力的重构精度。
en_tdlr: Proposes CP-GAMP, which uses Gaussian message approximations and a Bernoulli-Gaussian prior with EM updates to avoid high-dimensional matrix inversions, substantially reducing runtime while maintaining competitive reconstruction accuracy in large-scale Bayesian tensor completion.
